experiment_data.hypothesis: K=2 per-layer KL at 30% sparsity: training with 2 random layers per step. Part of K-curve {1,2,4,8,16,32}. K=2 is between K=1 (per-layer) and K=4 (partial coupling), tests whether even minimal cross-layer interaction improves over pure per-layer training.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/distill_sparse_swiglu && WANDB_MODE=disabled python -u src/train_perlayer_kl_k4.py --num_masked_layers 2 --seed 42 --num_steps 1000 --save_every 500 --gradient_checkpointing --output_dir /root/distill_sparse_swiglu/checkpoints/perlayer_kl_k2_s42 --gpu 0"
